current_point.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要技术将动态时序图映射为固定规模的新图，解决GNN输出无法直接输入RNN训练的问题，并利用图自编码器与循环神经网络学习时序特征。
current_point.claim_en: Propose a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which maps dynamic sequential graphs to fixed-size new graphs via graph summarization, addressing the issue that GNN outputs cannot be directly fed into RNN, and uses graph autoencoder and recurrent neural network to learn temporal features.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻原图快照的序列
通过图摘要技术压缩原图，生成固定规模的新图
将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器，利用与原图的重构误差训练原图节点表征
将单时间步图表征输入循环神经网络，学习时间维度特征与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each time step
Compress the original graph via graph summarization to generate a fixed-size new graph
Input the compressed new graph into a graph autoencoder and train node representations using reconstruction error with the original graph
Feed single-time-step graph representations into a recurrent neural network to learn temporal features and dependencies
